title: Observation: watcher, telemetry, project feed
summary: Theme Dossier for the observation area, created by AGT-2800 under the operator's D1 decision on AGT-W55 (2026-09-13). It merges AGT-W15 Global Orchestrator Watcher (observe-first design, autonomy classes A0-A3, five detector classes, ticket proposals in review mode, delivered slices AGT-2654 and AGT-2721), AGT-W38 organization-wide telemetry layer (hybrid local JSONL plus best-effort local push, privacy posture, signal-to-action vocabulary, Agent Studio as operations hub) and AGT-W16 project feed (three audiences, deterministic incremental composition, cached batch rollups, visible token cost, the external-chat data gap) into one stack with four separate truths: the file, the cluster, the case and the projection. Observing never mutates; every action runs through the existing application authorities. Ten open decisions arrived unanswered from the sources and are kept as inline decision blocks: safe-rescue authority, fence policy, proposal auto-approval, telemetry transport, telemetry pilot, operations-hub positioning, feed curation, decision capture, rollup budget and the stakeholder sharing boundary.
